findings.summary: The [AC:spec-10-1] test claims the queue from the linked tree, so the lease root equals the tree itself; it cannot tell the lease branch from the self fallback, and no test covers the worktrees.mjs record branch. A scratch probe showed both branches correct.
findings.assumption: The spec names only this test as the check; coverage of the record and lease branches is a later test addition, not a blocker.

findings.summary: spec-10-2 is untraced (no [AC:spec-10-2] tag); the spec names [AC:sl2-06a-help], [AC:sl2-06a-defaults] and [AC:sl3-07-words] as its checks, and those pass.

Probe: a lease root edited to ../../../../etc moves the default expected manifest outside the repo. The lease is a local coordinator file, trusted the same way parallelWorkspace already trusts it; not a regression for outside input.
